description: This file implements the ProjectDao interface for database operations related to the Project entity, using Hibernate sessions. It provides methods to retrieve, save, and remove projects.

classes.name: ProjectDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProjectDao interface for Hibernate-based database interactions.

methods.name: retrieveProject
methods.description: Retrieves a Project entity from the database by its ID.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Persists a Project entity into the database.

methods.name: removeProject
methods.description: Deletes a Project entity from the database by its ID.
